functionalRequirement: Faculties shall be able to upload and download assignments, college notices, student notices, journals, and videos.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support uploading and downloading of assignments, college notices, student notices, journals, and videos for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies various document types that faculties need to manage, requiring comprehensive functionality to cover all specified use cases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide a user-friendly interface that enables faculties to upload and download documents with no more than 3 clicks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ease of use is critical for faculties to efficiently manage their documents, ensuring they can quickly learn and perform these tasks.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must complete upload and download operations within 5 seconds for files up to 100 MB.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Timely uploads and downloads are essential for maintaining an efficient workflow for faculties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for document uploads and downloads 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Continuous access to the system is necessary for faculties to perform their tasks without interruptions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that all uploaded documents are stored without alteration and maintain a checksum for verification.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensuring the integrity of documents is crucial as faculties rely on accurate and unaltered submissions.

functionalRequirement: System shall allow users to rate and review services by providing comments on tour plans or services, with comments stored in the database and a thank you message displayed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must allow users to submit ratings and comments for 100% of the available tour plans and services.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies that users should be able to review all services, necessitating complete functionality for all offerings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must display a thank you message immediately after a user submits a rating or comment, enhancing user satisfaction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Providing immediate feedback to users after their action encourages engagement and positive user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and store user comments in the database within 2 seconds of submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick processing of user inputs is essential to maintain user interest and satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for users to submit ratings and comments 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: High availability is necessary to ensure that users can always provide feedback on services.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that user comments and ratings are stored securely and are only accessible to authorized personnel.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protecting user data is critical to maintain trust and comply with privacy regulations.
